_doc: Detail floor thresholds (owner 2026-11-22). One source: read by tools/3d/detail/detail.py (Studio projects) and tools/roblox/detail-check.mjs (Roblox models). Rules: domains/3d/detail.md.

definitions.parts: visible geometry objects (Studio part|mesh; Roblox BasePart incl. MeshPart/UnionOperation), not lights, groups, helpers, transparency >= 0.95
definitions.mesh_ratio: custom meshes / parts (Studio type mesh; Roblox MeshPart or UnionOperation or SpecialMesh with MeshId)
definitions.textured_ratio: textured / non-glow parts. Textured = Studio texture set; Roblox TextureID, SurfaceAppearance, Texture/Decal child, or Material not Plastic/SmoothPlastic. Glow = Neon material, excluded
definitions.colors: distinct colours after rounding each RGB channel to 16 levels
definitions.tris: total triangles (Studio from geo faces, quads = 2; Roblox: MeshPart TriangleCount if readable else skip the check)
definitions.same_size_ratio: largest group of parts sharing an identical size (rounded to 0.01) / parts; catches even repetition
